axes.name: decl_order
axes.rationale: Entry-hoist test: does declaration order of the handle/out-pointer locals affect which one the compiler homes into SI/DI at prologue.
values:

    unsigned int far *out;

axes.name: local_scope
axes.rationale: Entry-hoist test: assign handle and/or handleOut to a local (Recruit-style) before first use, per the accepted-source idiom of copying a re-used parameter to a local so the compiler loads it into SI/DI at entry, versus leaving one or both as raw parameter references.

spec.semantic_summary: Batch: local-variable copies of handle/handleOut (both, handle-only, out-only) crossed with their declaration order, to reproduce the target's unconditional SI/DI entry hoist of both parameters (mov si,[bp+0xe]; mov di,[bp+0xa]), following the Recruit-style local-copy idiom.
binding_evidence: Candidate declarations and source comments; inspect packet bindings before acceptance

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
